title: JAR (Java Archive) signature
summary: A JAR file is a ZIP archive containing Java classes, resources, and a manifest (META-INF/MANIFEST.MF). The magic is the standard ZIP signature 0x50 0x4B 0x03 0x04.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: MANIFEST.MF contains metadata: Main-Class, Class-Path, etc.
JAR is used for Java applications and libraries.
